title: Don’t buy it.
text: Don’t buy it.. This was a joke. I felt like I bought some kids fake kitchen product. I immediately returned it. It doesn’t cut at all and is so flimsy. Completely over priced for junk. I’m not sure how others are leaving good reviews for this. But that’s a no from me.

product_metadata.title: Westmark Germany Multipurpose Stainless Steel Cheese and Food Slicer with Board and Adjustable Thickness Dial (White) -
features: MADE IN GERMANY HIGH QUALITY KITCHENWARE: Westmark’s Cheese and Food Slicer with Board is among the best in the world and is rated to be one of the best kitchenware brands available today.

MATERIAL: Each product is made using a high quality stainless steel blade and high quality cast aluminum for its handle. the base of the board is made from ABS with a polypropylene adjustable scale. See below for more details.

EASY TO CLEAN: Simply use soap and water to clean the product.
